title: Disco Raja
desc: A ground-breaking scientific experiment brings a deceased man to life. However, things take a turn when he tries to escape the facility after waking up with no memories.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Arrambam
desc: Ashok, a former member of the ATS, along with Arjun, a computer hacker, and his girlfriend Anitha, tries to unveil a scam involving the bulletproof jackets provided to police officers.

title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: The Game
desc: Detective Seo Joon-Young teams up with Kim Tae-Pyung to resolve a serial killer case using Tae-Pyung's unique ability to predict a person's death.

title: Aranmanai
desc: A family returns to their hometown to sell their ancestral palace. However, their arrival is marred by supernatural events, and Ravi, a relative of the family, decides to uncover the truth.
